findings.summary: Capability e2e (pnpm exec playwright test tests/e2e/actions.spec.ts) was not run: tests/e2e/actions.spec.ts belongs to a sibling unit and is not part of this unit's Done when; AC-ra-26/27/28/30/63 browser evidence is deferred to integration.
Play dev-link walkthrough (change status + undo, reload, edit one action, closed plan in #/resultado/d1) was not run: no live Play preview in this unattended session.
src/App.tsx has no route for empresa/:companyId/relatorios although CompanyTabs and ResultPage link to it (ReportCenterPage is unrouted). Outside this unit's scope; left untouched.

ActionPlanList.progress is optional so src/features/home/OwnerHome.tsx (not in this unit) keeps compiling with plan only; 'Suas 3 ações' with editable progress on the owner home is Phase 5 (AC-ra-26 home part).

evidence.summary: tsc --noEmit over src, server, shared, tests: no errors

Screens use only IF-005 (src/api/actionsApi.ts): CompanyActionsTab -> getCompanyActions; ResultPage -> getDiagnosisActions (+ getCompanyActions only to date a closed plan); useActionStatus and ActionEditDialog -> updateAction. No direct fetch.

AC-ra-26: ActionProgressRow shows status, deadline chip (Prazo/Sem prazo/Vencida em), owner role chip and note in the Ações tab and the result. AC-ra-27: useActionStatus saves at once, UndoNotice role=status shows '"{title}" agora está {estado}.' with Desfazer for 6000 ms; undo PATCHes the previous status. AC-ra-28: ActionEditDialog with DateField (inputMode numeric, maxLength 10, DD/MM/AAAA mask, getDateError on blur), role select without name field, note maxLength 500 with counter; PATCH keyed by diagnosisId/actionKey; dialog reseeds from the saved row. AC-ra-30: result of a replaced plan (isCurrent=false) renders ClosedPlanRows without controls with 'Encerrada em {data} · {estado}'. AC-ra-63: CompanyActionsTab empty state 'Ainda não há ações' explaining actions come from a completed diagnosis, with 'Continuar o diagnóstico' (draft) or 'Começar o diagnóstico'.

messages.text: Run the deferred capability checks: pnpm exec playwright test tests/e2e/actions.spec.ts tests/e2e/result.spec.ts tests/e2e/history.spec.ts, plus the Play dev-link walkthrough (status change + Desfazer + reload; Editar on one action; #/resultado/<older> shows closed actions without controls; #/empresa/<id>/acoes without completed diagnosis shows the empty state). Stable hooks: data-aioson-id company-actions, actions-list, actions-empty, closed-actions, action-<diagnosisId>-<actionKey>, status-<diagnosisId>-<actionKey> (select, label 'Estado de {title}'), edit-<diagnosisId>-<actionKey> (button name 'Editar prazo, responsável e nota de {title}'), action-status-notice (+ -undo), action-edit-modal/-form/-due/-role/-note/-note-count/-submit, result-actions-list, result-actions-closed, result-plan-closed.

src/App.tsx has no <Route path="relatorios"> under empresa/:companyId, yet CompanyTabs ('Relatórios') and ResultPage link to /empresa/:id/relatorios. Wire ReportCenterPage there if no other unit owns it.

ActionPlanList now takes an optional progress prop (ActionPlanProgress: loading | error{retry} | ready{isCurrent, actions, closedBy}). Without it, it renders the static plan as before; OwnerHome ('Suas 3 ações', Phase 5) can pass progress or reuse TrackedActionRows from src/features/actions/ActionProgressRow.tsx to get editable status + undo.
The 'Ações' tab has no overdue counter badge (prototype shows 'N vencidas'): Company has no overdue field; add it when the portfolio/home followup exposes it.
